topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
consensus_response: On-board storage constraints significantly impact payload power allocation by necessitating a balance between immediate and time-tagged services. DLB's dynamic power allocation strategy, combined with PNM's predictive analytics, optimizes performance under memory limits, minimizing latency and waste while maintaining QoS.
reference_context: SatCom systems face trade-offs between fixed and dynamic capacity allocation, impacting latency and resource utilization.
